# WoWAnalyzer Copilot Instructions (Agent Routing)

- Ask follow-up questions as per **[Follow-up Questions](instructions/follow-up-questions.instructions.md)**

## Routing

When performing a code review, apply the checks in **[PR Review](instructions/copilot-pr-review.instructions.md)**.

When validating changes locally, use **[Build & Testing](instructions/build.instructions.md)**.

When implementing or modifying analyzers/modules, follow **[Analyzer Patterns](instructions/analyzer-patterns.md)**.

When writing event listeners or filters, follow **[Event Listeners](instructions/event-listeners.md)**.

When adding/changing normalizers or event linking/order, follow **[Normalizers](instructions/normalizers.md)**.

When you need known-good implementations to copy patterns from, start with **[Reference Examples](instructions/reference-examples.md)**.

When you need to verify a spell/talent/module/event type exists before coding, follow **[Verification](instructions/verification.md)**.

When you need a quick orientation on tools/stack/project layout, read **[Tech Stack](instructions/tech-stack.md)**.

## Notes for agents

- Prefer following a real in-repo example before inventing a new pattern.
